visualCharacteristics: White background, minimal chrome, single full-width responsive 16:9 video centered on the page (max-width 800px). No overlaid text or captions.
contentPattern: One block with a single cell containing an external video URL (YouTube or Vimeo). An optional poster image above the link becomes a click-to-play placeholder.
usage: Use to embed a single external video (YouTube/Vimeo) inline in the page flow.
